summary: Iteration 17: tested AI-composed workspace (Graph/List/Week/Report, filter, Add menu, inspector, relationships, assistant compose + receipt Undo/Show changes), customer quote lifecycle (draft->issue->copy link->customer code verify->accept/decline, amendment keeps baseline), voice (Whisper via composer mic with fake device) and photo (Claude vision via composer camera), and mobile 390px. New backend suite 10/10 pass; full regression 105/105 pass. Found and FIXED one crash: Report view threw 'p.conditions.map is not a function' (partner.conditions is a string in fixtures). Found one HIGH backend validation hole: client-supplied 'restore' op in POST /api/project/items/ops bypasses all validation and upserts by bare item_id.

critical.issue: Client can send {op:'restore', doc:{...}} and the raw doc is written with NO validation (verified: kind='bogus_kind', status='hacked', firm_id='unknown_firm', due_date='not-a-date', arbitrary item_id/created_by all persisted, 200). Write uses replace_one({'item_id': ...}) without project_id filter, so a known foreign item_id would be overwritten (cross-project write). Bogus kind will also break frontend (STATUS_OPTIONS[kind].map). Fix: only allow 'restore' (and edge_id reuse) when inverse_of is set (undo path), or re-validate via clean_fields + KINDS; add project_id to replace_one filters.

minor.issue: Frontend sends naive datetime-local (user's local time); backend treats naive as UTC and customer page shows '... UTC'. A PT user entering 17:00 gets 17:00 UTC. Convert to ISO with offset on the client (new Date(v).toISOString()).
Whisper returned 'You' for non-speech audio (fake mic tone) — classic hallucination. Consider verbose_json + no_speech_prob / min-duration filter to return 'No speech was recognized'.
customer_email only checked for '@' (missing() ), no format validation.

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime crash 'p.conditions.map is not a function' when opening Report (partner.conditions is a string). FIXED by tester with Array.isArray guard.

issues: Composer textarea is squeezed into a ~100px column to the right of Add/attach/camera/mic buttons; placeholder 'Ask or describe a change...' wraps to 3 lines and typed text wraps word-per-line. Put the textarea on its own full-width row above the action buttons on narrow screens.
Overflow '...' button wraps onto its own row below Filter/Guided tour; title bar consumes ~310px of 844px height. Put overflow inline with view switch or the filter row.
Toasts overlap AppHeader 'My reviews'/'Sign out' buttons; offset below the 52px header.
Edge line from Task Two to Task One passes through the Task One card and terminates at the group title, not at the card edge.
After a rejected change (loop error), header shows red 'Not saved' although nothing is pending; error is already shown in inspector + toast.
Incoming prerequisite reads 'TEST Task Two → prerequisite' — unclear; use 'TEST Task Two must finish before this'.
Firms with no sites show a dangling '·' (List) or '—' (Report Scope coverage) with nothing after; show 'no sites assigned'.
Item subtitle shows literal 'date' when date_kind is unset. Week view starts at job start (2026-10-26) and does not jump to earliest dated item.
'Guided tour' button uses a sparkle icon; user asked for no sparkle in composer — confirm this is acceptable in the header.

passed_flows: Login demo organizer -> project-row-12-branch-lighting-retrofit; AppHeader 'Assemble | Brightline Electrical | History | Projects | My reviews | Sign out', SYNTHETIC badge, status-sentence, 4 view toggles, toolbar-search, header-overflow; no left rail (workspace-project-rail absent)
Graph: Firms and sites frame with 6 card-plan-* cards, Open conditions frame; zoom in 1.1 / out 0.9 / fit 1.0

Add menu -> group (inspector opens, rename on blur saves) -> task with parent group + due date; second task with prerequisite; reverse prerequisite rejected with loop error in inspector-errors; Escape closes inspector

List view inline rename + done checkbox persist; Week view dated task on week-day-2026-11-04 via week-next, undated in week-unscheduled; Report sections coverage/quotes/conditions/responses/work render (after fix)
Filter narrows cards 11->2, filter-conditions-note '3 open conditions in this project' stays visible incl. no-match
Composer: Shift+Enter newline; Enter sends; tray opens; assistant created 4 groups/9 items; receipt with Show changes and Undo; Undo removed all, receipt shows 'Undone'; no 'by assistant' label
All Add menu items open the right tool sheets (details/source/check/review/quote)

Quote: missing price listed in quote-missing, no issue button; price 900 -> preview $900.00 -> issue Q1 -> copy link; customer fresh context: synthetic code shown, wrong code -> quote-verify-error, right code -> document $900.00; accept without name -> 'Type your full name.'; with name+intent -> Accepted + receipt; reload keeps Accepted
Organizer shows 'Draft an amendment'; Q2 amendment ($1,200) shows 'Your accepted Q1 stays in force'; customer declines -> Q2 Declined, Q1 stays Accepted
Camera button upload -> observations note in tray + composer prefilled with 'Use the observations from photo ...' (not sent)
Mic button (fake device) -> recording -> stop -> transcript placed in input, voice-review-note shown, not auto-sent
Mobile 390: List default on fresh visit, scrollWidth==clientWidth (no overflow), inspector full-screen 390x844 with 'Back' which closes it
action_items: HIGH: Lock down op=restore in apply_ops (only from undo/inverse_of path or validate fully) and scope item/edge replace_one filters by project_id
Fix mobile composer layout (full-width textarea on narrow screens) and mobile header overflow wrap
Send valid_until with timezone offset from QuotePanel
Offset toasts below AppHeader; fix 'Not saved' state after rejected ops; clarify incoming relationship text; remove dangling separators in List/Report; hide 'date' label in Week when date_kind unset
Optional: filter Whisper no-speech hallucinations; delete unused ProjectRail.jsx
critical_code_review_comments: items_routes.apply_ops: 'restore' and client-provided edge objects are trusted; inverse ops should be server-only. replace_one/update_one keyed only by item_id/edge_id (no project_id) — tenant isolation relies on id secrecy.

quote_routes.respond: expiry guard compares snapshot.valid_until string to now().isoformat()[:16]; works for naive 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM' but brittle if offsets are added — compare parsed datetimes or store a normalized UTC field.
quote_routes.missing(): datetime.fromisoformat(...).replace(tzinfo=utc) discards a real offset if one is supplied (should be astimezone or only set tzinfo when naive).
ReportView assumed partner.conditions is an array; fixture data has strings — normalize at the data layer.
ProjectRail.jsx is dead code after rail removal.

success_rate.backend: 100% of tests (115/115 incl. regression); 1 HIGH validation hole found by probe

test_credentials: organizer@demo.assemble.test / synthetic-demo via signin-demo-organizer-button (per visitor_id sandbox)
seed_data_creation: Only per-visitor demo sandboxes (TEST_ prefixed items/quotes); one injected item 'itm_injected' in a throwaway sandbox from the restore probe.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App env date is Oct 2026 (job starts 2026-10-26), so use due dates around Nov 2026 for Week tests. Each fresh browser context = new sandbox. Quote link via clipboard (grant clipboard-read). Mic works in Playwright after grant_permissions(['microphone']) (fake device -> Whisper returns 'You'). Retest: restore-op hole (/tmp/t17_restore.py reproduces), mobile composer layout, ReportView fix.
rca of the issue: Report crash: ReportView line 46 called p.conditions.map but fixtures store partner.conditions as a string or null; non-empty string passes ?.length check then .map throws. Restore hole: apply_ops treats op=restore as trusted inverse data, but post_ops passes user ops straight through; repro: POST /api/project/items/ops {rev, ops:[{op:'restore', doc:{item_id:'x', project_id:<own>, kind:'bogus'}}]} -> 200 and persisted.
